reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that pagecache folios in MAP_SHARED VMAs do not require unsharing, and suggested the patch is about 'number of pages that don't need unsharing'. He also asked for a fitting name.
reviews.raw_body:
Not quite the right semantics. For pagecache folios we simply don't need
unsharing in MAP_SHARED VMAs. That does not imply that these are exclusive.

So it's all about "number of pages that don't need unsharing".

Any idea for a fitting name ? :)

-- 
Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Yeoreum Yun
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested an alternative name for the function, gup_pages_without_unshared(), and expressed uncertainty about whether the current name is better.
reviews.raw_body:
Might gup_pages_without_unshared()..? otherwise I couldn't image 
better name than origin...

-- 
Sincerely,
Yeoreum Yun

reviews.author: Rik Riel (author)
reviews.summary: Author responded to a suggestion from David (Arm) that gup_exclusive_pages() might be a better name for the function, and explained that they chose 'gup_unshared_pages()' because it accurately describes its purpose.
reviews.raw_body:
gup_no_unshare_len() ?

a little awkward sounding, but it describes
what it's doing?


-- 
All Rights Reversed.

reviews.author: Yeoreum Yun
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the proposed name gup_exclusive_pages() has similar semantics to the existing gup_unshared_page(), potentially making it redundant, and suggested considering a different name
reviews.raw_body:
Hmm, Wouldn't this name be semantically much the same as keeping
the existing gup_unshared_page(), since both essentially convey that
no unsharing is required from GUP's perspective?

Anyway, naming is always NP-hard problem :\


-- 
Sincerely,
Yeoreum Yun

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David expressed uncertainty about the functionality of gup_skip_unshare_pages, but did not provide further details or suggestions.

reviews.author: Rik Riel (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged Yeoreum Yun's suggestion for a better function name, but expressed preference for the current one and emphasized desire to get the code merged so they can proceed with their own GUP series.
sentiment_signals: expressed no strong opinion on naming
reviews.raw_body:
The function measures how many pages in
this current interval do not need to be
unshared.

I'm happy with any name, though.

I would really like to just see this
code go in, so I can post my two
GUP series on top, first the batching
for the GUP-slow path, and then the
series that allows access_remote_vm()
and friends to work under the per-VMA
lock.

-- 
All Rights Reversed.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch introduces gup_unshared_pages(), a new function in the mm/gup.c file, which is part of the Linux kernel's memory management system. The function appears to be related to page fault handling and possibly improving performance by reducing shared page faults. However, without more context, it's unclear what specific problem this patch solves or how it addresses it.
